summary.intent: Replace the Ted Lasso quotes/theme on the site's front page with Machiavelli quotes, and then push the resulting changes to the branch.
summary.outcome: Rewrote the mood catalogue (10 moods, 35 Machiavelli quotes from The Prince and Discourses on Livy), renamed engine mood ids end-to-end across src and tests, updated docs (README, CLAUDE.md) and page copy (title suffix, catalogue link text), rewrote/adjusted affected tests to keep them honest about the now-media-less catalogue, verified 333 tests pass with clean typecheck and preserved coverage, visually inspected rendered HTML output, and staged changes for push.

repo: All mood/quote/media data lives in src/data/moods.ts as the single source of truth (MOODS array + getMood()), consumed by src/domain/mood.ts (engine), src/app/render.ts, src/app/catalogue.ts, and src/worker.ts — never hardcode mood copy in rendering or engine logic.

Mood ids are load-bearing: src/domain/mood.ts returns them and snapshots store them, so renaming an id requires touching the engine, worker fallback constant, render.ts fallback constant, and every test fixture referencing that id.

test/data/moods.test.ts enforces a REQUIRED_IDS list, WCAG accent contrast checks, and well-formedness of media entries — but must not assert on how many moods currently have media, since zero is a legal state.
Accent hex colors are pre-verified for WCAG contrast against both newsprint stocks in test/data/moods.test.ts; reusing the same accent per engine slot avoids re-verification.

Media type (gif/image/video) rendering paths in render.ts/catalogue.ts stay in the code even with an empty catalogue — they're exercised via synthetic fixtures in test/domain/quote.test.ts and test/app/render.test.ts rather than real data.

Repo name, Worker name, and REDIRECT_URI intentionally keep the 'tedlasso-strava' identifier even after a full content rebrand, since renaming them breaks the deployed URL and Strava OAuth callback — only page-facing copy (title, catalogue text) was rebranded.

catalogue.test.ts's staleness marker test previously aged the clock past the newest verifiedOn to prove the marker renders; with an all-empty media catalogue this became unsatisfiable and was rewritten to assert no marker ever raises regardless of clock.

code.finding: Quote/Media/Mood interfaces unchanged; Media.kind supports gif/image/video with video intentionally rendered as a link rather than embedded iframe to avoid third-party embeds dominating the page.
Contains only the 10 moodId string literals tied to engine branch outcomes — no thresholds or reasons copy lives here, so renaming ids is a pure string-literal swap.
Has a PRESEASON_MOOD/PEACETIME_MOOD constant derived via requireMood('peacetime') used as the fallback mood when no snapshot exists yet.

Staleness-marker test rewritten to assert MOODS.flatMap(media) is empty and that no clock offset produces a 'stale-marker', since the real isGifStale rule is now only exercised via synthetic data in render.test.ts.

workflow: Used superpowers:brainstorming skill plus AskUserQuestion to resolve a scope-defining decision (whether to keep engine ids or remap them) before implementing, since it changed the shape of the whole task.
Followed TDD: updated test fixtures/ids first (expecting red), ran full suite to confirm expected failures, then rewrote the data file and engine ids, then iterated to green.

Used python3 heredoc scripts via Bash for bulk find/replace across many files (id renames, quote/fixture swaps) rather than many individual Edit calls — efficient for repetitive mechanical substitutions with asserted preconditions (assert old in t) to catch drift.

Rendered actual HTML output via a temporary esbuild-bundled dump script (writing page.html/catalogue.html to a scratch dir) to visually verify the change instead of trusting tests alone, then cleaned up the temp script.
Ran npm run typecheck and npx vitest run --coverage as final verification gates before declaring done.

friction: node_modules wasn't installed initially, requiring an npm install detour before tests could run.
Bulk python3 substitution scripts needed multiple iterations (e.g., path fixups for the esbuild dump script's relative import paths) before the HTML dump actually worked.

One test (refresh.test.ts's catalogue-GIF verifiedOn propagation test) and one (catalogue.test.ts's staleness marker test) permanently lost real coverage of certain code paths because the new catalogue ships no media — flagged explicitly to the user rather than silently patched over.
open_items: The two-column quote+media hero layout, staleness marker, and video/still rendering paths are now only covered by synthetic test fixtures, not real catalogue data, since no media currently exists in src/data/moods.ts — future work could source verified Machiavelli-related imagery to re-populate media.

Changes are committed to branch change-front-page-ted-lasso-quotes-to-be-machiav locally but push to remote had not yet completed in the visible transcript (user asked to push, git add -u and status were run last).
